title: Own krn state in one place: bin/krn vs global install
body: Found 2026-11-07: after #268 removed legacy forwarding, repo `bin/krn state ...` exits 64 (unknown command) while PATH `krn` (~/.local/bin/krn -> ~/.codex/krn/releases/<sha>/scripts/krn.mjs, GLOBAL install) still owns `state resume|check`. Skills say `krn state` (PATH) but also `bin/krn review`; a lead mixing them hits exit 64. Decide one owner: port `state resume|check` into Product bin/krn, or make skills/docs say explicitly that state lives in the global krn and bin/krn prints that pointer for `state`.
